summary_of_core_decisions: The text argues that modern technology, as Enframing, reduces all beings to standing-reserve and is rooted in the metaphysics of the will to power. Art, as the setting-into-work of truth, opens a world while preserving earth, thereby disclosing beings without exhausting them. The saving power of art lies not in escaping technology or restoring a fixed human essence, but in a change of revealing: art interrupts the demand for total availability and teaches humanity to attend to the revealing and concealing of Being.
